```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Ensure all tables render inline at 10pt body font size without horizontal overflow or float page isolation,
# and replace em/en-dashes with plain hyphens (-).
sanitize_latex_text <- function (arg0_text, arg1_in_table = FALSE) {
  text <- as.character(arg0_text)
  if (length(text) == 0 || is.na(text) || !nzchar(text)) return("")
  text <- gsub("`", "", text, fixed = TRUE)
  parts <- strsplit(text, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  out_parts <- character(length(parts))
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
      out_parts[i] <- "$"
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "^2", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      out_parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)&", "\\\\&", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)_", "\\\\_", p, perl = TRUE)
      if (isTRUE(arg1_in_table)) {
        p <- gsub("\\_", "\\_\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("/", "/\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        # Keep thousands-separated numbers and BC/AD dates on a single line inside table cells
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("([0-9])\\s*(BC|AD)\\b", "\\1\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
        # Prevent line breaks immediately after a leading negative sign (e.g. -10000)
        p <- gsub("(^|\\s|\\()-([0-9])", "\\1\\\\mbox{-}\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
      }
      out_parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(out_parts, collapse = ""))
}

sanitize_prose_unicode_for_latex <- function (arg0_line) {
  line_str <- as.character(arg0_line)
  if (length(line_str) == 0 || is.na(line_str) || !nzchar(line_str)) return(line_str)
  parts <- strsplit(line_str, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", " \\approx ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub(
        "\\b(Figures?|Figs?\\.|Tables?|Tabs?\\.|Images?|Definitions?|Sections?|Appendix)(?:\\s+|~)\\\\ref\\{([^}]+)\\}",
        "\\\\crdxref{\\1}{\\2}",
        p,
        perl = TRUE
      )
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", "~", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(parts, collapse = ""))
}

orig_render_figure_template <- render_figure_template
render_figure_template <- function (arg0_file_path, arg1_options = NULL) {
  options <- if (!is.null(arg1_options)) arg1_options else list()
  options$placement <- "!htbp"
  if (is.null(options$max_height) || identical(options$max_height, "none")) {
    options$max_height <- "0.42\\textheight"
  }
  return(orig_render_figure_template(arg0_file_path, options))
}
```

```{r load-stadester-json, include=FALSE}
summary_meta <- jsonlite::fromJSON((if (file.exists("imperial_russia_pre_1815_summary.json")) "imperial_russia_pre_1815_summary.json" else "../../_shared/_gis_cache/imperial_russia_pre_1815_summary.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE)

fmt_eu_pop <- function(val) {
  if (is.null(val) || is.na(val)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(val)
  if (v <= 0) return("-")
  if (v >= 1000000) {
    m <- round(v / 1000000, 2)
    s <- gsub("\\.", ",", format(m, nsmall = 2, trim = TRUE))
    s <- sub(",00$", "", s)
    s <- sub("(,[1-9])0$", "\\1", s)
    return(paste0(s, "M"))
  }
  if (v >= 1000) {
    k <- round(v / 1000, 1)
    if (k == floor(k)) {
      return(paste0(as.integer(k), "k"))
    }
    return(paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", format(k, nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE)), "k"))
  }
  return(as.character(as.integer(round(v))))
}

fmt_eu_coord <- function(x) {
  s <- format(round(as.numeric(x), 2), nsmall = 2, trim = TRUE)
  gsub("\\.", ",", s)
}

get_entry_pop <- function(entry, yr_str) {
  p <- entry$population[[yr_str]]
  if (is.null(p)) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(p)
}

fmt_pct_change <- function(entry) {
  p1 <- get_entry_pop(entry, "1721")
  p2 <- get_entry_pop(entry, "1815")
  if (is.na(p2) || p2 <= 0) return("-")
  if (is.na(p1) || p1 <= 0) return("New")
  pct <- round((p2 - p1) / p1 * 100, 1)
  sign_s <- if (pct > 0) "+" else ""
  paste0(sign_s, sub(",0$", "", gsub("\\.", ",", format(pct, nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE))), "%")
}

hyphenate_pre1815_words <- function(s) {
  s <- as.character(s)
  s <- gsub("Verkhneudinsk", "Verkhne-udinsk", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Petropavlovskaya", "Petropavlov-skaya", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Petropavlovsk", "Petropav-lovsk", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Starocherkasskaya", "Starocher-kasskaya", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Starocherkassk", "Starocher-kassk", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Nizhnekamchatsk", "Nizhne-kamchatsk", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s
}

build_region_df <- function(reg_slug) {
  sub_list <- Filter(function(e) identical(as.character(reg40_map[[e$key]]), as.character(reg_slug)), all_entries)
  sub_list <- sub_list[order(sapply(sub_list, function(e) {
    v <- get_entry_pop(e, "1815")
    if (is.na(v)) 0 else -v
  }))]
  rows <- lapply(sub_list, function(e) {
    raw_oth <- if (length(e$other_names) > 0) unlist(e$other_names) else character(0)
    if (length(raw_oth) > 1) {
      oth <- paste(head(raw_oth, 2L), collapse = "; ")
    } else if (length(raw_oth) == 1) {
      oth <- raw_oth[1]
    } else {
      oth <- "-"
    }
    coords_span <- paste0(
      fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[1]]), ", ", fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[2]]),
      " (", e$country, ")"
    )
    data.frame(
      `Settlement` = hyphenate_pre1815_words(e$name),
      `Alternative / Historical Names` = hyphenate_pre1815_words(oth),
      `Coords & Country` = coords_span,
      `1721AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "1721")),
      `1762AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "1762")),
      `1795AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "1795")),
      `1811AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "1811")),
      `1815AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "1815")),
      `Change` = fmt_pct_change(e),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
```

```{=latex}
\emergencystretch=1.5em
```

# Abstract

This gazetteer compiles population estimates for 224 towns, ports, fortresses, market towns (*miasteczka*) and factory settlements across the 40 provinces and frontier regions of the Russian Empire and its neighbouring partition lands between the Peace of Nystad (1721AD) and the Congress of Vienna (1815AD). Arranged across the Baltic provinces and Finland, the Polish-Lithuanian partition lands and Galicia, Ukraine and Novorossiya, Central Russia and the Volga-Urals, the Caucasus and Siberia, the tables follow urban growth across five Soul Revision benchmarks (1721, 1762, 1795, 1811 and 1815AD). Over these nine decades, the rapid rise of Saint Petersburg, the founding of new Black Sea ports led by Odessa, Kherson and Sevastopol, the growth of Ural and Altai iron and silver works and the annexation of Polish-Lithuanian market towns reshaped the urban map, even as the 1771AD plague and the 1812AD fire and retreat inflicted sharp losses on Moscow, Smolensk, Vitebsk and Vilna.

# Methodology

This gazetteer presents population estimates for 224 towns, fortress settlements, maritime ports, market towns (*miasteczka* or *shtetlekh*), colonist centres, Ural and Altai iron and silver works (*gornye zavody*) and Siberian *ostrogi* across the 40 provinces and frontier regions of Early Imperial Russia and its adjacent partition lands between 1721AD and 1815AD [@Kabuzan1963; @Kabuzan1971; @Vodarsky1973; @Mironov1990Urban]. Across the entire 40-region area (18,5M km²), total population more than doubled from 23,89M in 1721AD to 51,17M in 1815AD (or from 22,26M to 47,82M within the 39 regions belonging to the Russian Empire in 1815AD, excluding Austrian Galicia and Bukovina). Each entry gives the settlement's main name, historical or local names, coordinates and modern country alongside its population at the principal revision benchmarks (1721AD, 1762AD, 1795AD, 1811AD and 1815AD).

Town figures draw on the merchant and townsmen (*posad* and *meshchane*) rolls of the first seven Imperial Soul Revisions (1719-1816AD) together with provincial police and military-statistical returns compiled by Boris Mironov, Yaroslav Vodarsky, Vladimir Kabuzan and Pyotr Keppen [@Mironov1990Urban; @Vodarsky1973; @Kabuzan1990; @Keppen1857]. Outside the Great Russian core, these returns are paired with Baltic German ploughland and Lutheran magistracy lists [@Hupel1774; @Palli1996], Swedish-Finnish *Tabellverket* town registers [@Jutikkala1965; @Turpeinen1979], Polish-Lithuanian hearth-tax (*podymne*) and Jewish *kahal* rolls alongside Austrian Galician conscriptions [@Kuklo2009; @Stampfer1995; @Fellerer2023Galicia], Novorossiya and Bessarabia colonist chancellery tables [@Skalkovsky1836; @Herlihy1986; @Bushin2011; @Feldman2023Bessarabia], Ural and Altai mining-chancellery inventories [@Portal1950; @Smirnov1992UralZavody; @Isaev2025AltaiCabinet] and Siberian post-road and *ostrog* returns [@Hartley2014; @Forsyth1992]. Ports, fortresses and factory towns founded after 1721AD - such as Ekaterinburg (1723AD), Orenburg (1735/1743AD), Barnaul (1730s), Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky (1740AD), Elisavetgrad (1754AD), Izhevsk (1760AD), Katharinenstadt (1765AD), Kherson (1778AD), Mariupol (1778AD), Sevastopol (1783AD), Simferopol (1784AD), Nikolaev (1789AD), Ekaterinodar (1793AD), Odessa (1794AD) and Novocherkassk (1805AD) - show a hyphen (`-`) before their foundation and `New` in the percentage change column.

```{r fig1-md-only, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (!knitr::is_latex_output()) {
  render_figure_template(
    "figures/imperial_russia_pre_1815_regional_map.png",
    list(
      caption = "The 40 provinces and 224 catalogued towns, ports, fortresses and factory settlements across the Russian Empire and adjacent partition lands from 1721AD to 1815AD.",

    )
  )
}
```

# Results

## Estland Governorate

Table \ref{tab:reg1-sites} lists the towns of Region 1 (Estland Governorate, 22,64k km²), where regional population rose from 105k in 1721AD to 228k in 1811AD and 232k in 1815AD (+121%) [@Palli1980; @Palli1996; @Hupel1774].

```{r table-reg1, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
df_reg1 <- build_region_df("ostsee_estland_governorate")
render_table_template(
  df_reg1,
  list(
    caption = "Recovery of Reval (Tallinn), Wesenberg, Hapsal, Weissenstein and the naval roadstead of Baltischport from the 1710AD Baltic plague to the eve of peasant emancipation in 1815AD.",
    label = "tab:reg1-sites"
  )
)
```

# Appendix

## Regional Summary of Towns

Table \ref{tab:regional-summary} sums the population of the 224 towns across all 40 regions from 1721AD to 1815AD [@Mironov1990Urban; @Kabuzan1971; @Keppen1857].

```{r table-regional-summary, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
regs_meta <- summary_meta$regions
yrs_sum <- c("1721", "1762", "1795", "1811", "1815")

sum_rows <- lapply(regs_meta, function(r) {
  rslug <- r$id
  short_nm <- sub("\\s*\\(.*", "", as.character(r$name))
  sub_e <- Filter(function(e) identical(as.character(reg40_map[[e$key]]), as.character(rslug)), all_entries)
  raw_v <- sapply(yrs_sum, function(y) {
    sum(sapply(sub_e, function(e) {
      v <- get_entry_pop(e, y)
      if (is.na(v)) 0 else v
    }))
  })
  pct <- if (raw_v[["1721"]] > 0) round((raw_v[["1815"]] - raw_v[["1721"]]) / raw_v[["1721"]] * 100, 1) else NA_real_
  pct_s <- if (is.na(pct)) "New" else paste0(if (pct > 0) "+" else "", sub(",0$", "", gsub("\\.", ",", format(pct, nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE))), "%")
  data.frame(
    `Region (Towns)` = paste0(short_nm, " (", length(sub_e), ")"),
    `1721AD` = fmt_eu_pop(raw_v[["1721"]]),
    `1762AD` = fmt_eu_pop(raw_v[["1762"]]),
    `1795AD` = fmt_eu_pop(raw_v[["1795"]]),
    `1811AD` = fmt_eu_pop(raw_v[["1811"]]),
    `1815AD` = fmt_eu_pop(raw_v[["1815"]]),
    `Change` = pct_s,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
df_sum <- do.call(rbind, sum_rows)

tot_raw <- sapply(yrs_sum, function(y) {
  sum(sapply(all_entries, function(e) {
    v <- get_entry_pop(e, y)
    if (is.na(v)) 0 else v
  }))
})
tot_pct <- round((tot_raw[["1815"]] - tot_raw[["1721"]]) / tot_raw[["1721"]] * 100, 1)
tot_pct_s <- paste0(if (tot_pct > 0) "+" else "", sub(",0$", "", gsub("\\.", ",", format(tot_pct, nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE))), "%")

tot_row <- data.frame(
  `Region (Towns)` = paste0("Total Towns (", length(all_entries), ")"),
  `1721AD` = fmt_eu_pop(tot_raw[["1721"]]),
  `1762AD` = fmt_eu_pop(tot_raw[["1762"]]),
  `1795AD` = fmt_eu_pop(tot_raw[["1795"]]),
  `1811AD` = fmt_eu_pop(tot_raw[["1811"]]),
  `1815AD` = fmt_eu_pop(tot_raw[["1815"]]),
  `Change` = tot_pct_s,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
df_sum <- rbind(df_sum, tot_row)

render_table_template(
  df_sum,
  list(
    caption = "Combined urban population of all 224 catalogued towns across each of the 40 regions at five revision benchmarks from 1721AD to 1815AD.",
    label = "tab:regional-summary"
  )
)
```
